decision.question: Take ASU-1 from basic engineering into FEED as the 500 t/d GOX pipeline supply?
alternatives: buy GOX over the fence from an industrial gas company at about the threshold price
a smaller ASU without liquid production (no LOX/LIN, no liquefier duty)

basis.specification: GOX 99.5 mol% O2, 30 barg at the battery limit (process/design-basis.yaml)
basis.boundary: ambient air intake to the GOX, GAN, LOX and LIN battery limits; cooling water and 6.6 kV power supplied by the site (not in the capital cost)
basis.location: assumed coastal industrial site, United States (prices at the US average)

capex.title: ISBL (given)
capex.source: Thunder Said Energy, 'Cryogenic air separation: costs and energy economics?' (data file, updated before 2025, no cost year stated; companion report 'Industrial gases: air separation units' dated 2023-05-31) gives an average all-in capital of about USD 200 per t/a of oxygen capacity (paraphrased); x 500 t/d x 365 d = 182,500 t/a. Taken as USD 2023, not escalated: if it were of 2024 the CEPCI factor would be about 1.00 (2023 annual 797.9, cost-basis.yaml; 2024 monthly values stayed just below 800, Chemical Engineering CEPCI updates 2024), far inside the class 5 range

capex.title: OSBL (offsites, utilities)
capex.source: the site supplies cooling water and power at the battery limit (basis.boundary); the all-in benchmark per tonne of capacity holds the plant's own offsites

flows.title: Electric power (6.6 kV grid supply)
flows.source: US EIA, Electricity sales, revenue and average price, 2023 data, Table 4: average price to the industrial sector, US total, 8.04 cents/kWh

flows.title: Condensate (MAC cooler drains; DCAC condensate into its circulating water)
flows.free: compressor cooler condensate to the site drain, no charge assumed

opex.title: Maintenance
opex.source: Towler and Sinnott, Chemical Engineering Design, fixed costs of production, maintenance typically 3 to 5 % of ISBL per year (low end for rotating equipment under contract)

opex.title: Operating labour
opex.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wages, May 2023, 51-8091 Chemical Plant and System Operators: national mean annual wage $79,450 (wage only)

opex.title: Insurance and local taxes
opex.source: Towler and Sinnott, Chemical Engineering Design, fixed costs of production, property taxes and insurance typically 1 to 2 % of fixed capital per year

scenarios.title: Industrial power at the Texas 2023 average
scenarios.source: US EIA table_5c, Texas industrial 2023, 6.60 cents/kWh

scenarios.title: Industrial power at the California 2023 average
scenarios.source: US EIA table_5c, California industrial 2023, 18.64 cents/kWh

scenarios.title: Capital at the market-report benchmark, scaled from 2,000 to 500 t/d
scenarios.source: Mordor Intelligence, Air Separation Unit market report, 2026 edition (page updated 2026-09-11): a 2,000 t/d plant costs about USD 250 to 300 million (paraphrased), no method and no cost year stated, not escalated to 2023; scaled to 500 t/d with the capacity exponent 0.6 (six-tenths rule, Towler and Sinnott, Chemical Engineering Design, ch. 7), ASSUMED

inputs.source: US EIA, Electricity sales, revenue and average price, 2023 data, Table 4: average price to the industrial sector, US total, 8.04 cents/kWh

screening real discount rate; the owner's hurdle rate is not given yet

checked: steps of the unit kinds compressor, pump, heater, cooler, shortcut_column, conversion_reactor, equilibrium_reactor, gibbs_reactor have an energy stream at a port (or are declared adiabatic)
every product terminal has a category
noted: every feed terminal has a category
energy terminals are classified utility; heat utilities declare a kind and supply temperature
not_checked: steps of other unit kinds (component separators, flash drums, mixers, splitters, unknown classes)
whether a step's energy stream reaches a utility terminal (a step-to-step stream counts)
whether duties are given or balance (cheme process energy)
